verdict.rationale: The Radeon RX 9070 XT is a discrete GPU, and a sandbox environment kept separate from production data is a service or API concept that does not apply to this kind of product. The ROCm Docker container docs describe reproducible GPU workload environments, not a vendor-provided test sandbox isolated from production data, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
